propositions: A portable, test-linked drift gate using pure stdlib (inspect/importlib) must detect when public symbols are removed, added, or have signature changes without adding new dependencies.

The gate derives the guarded surface from a pinned MODULES list (rebar facade + documented reuse subsystems) capturing each module's __all__ (if defined) or owned non-underscore attributes, pinning callable parameter lists, class bases, dataclass fields, and immutable constant values.

The hardcoded-subset assertions in test_reuse_surface_doc.py must be subsumed by the baseline with no coverage loss, verified by dedicated subsumption tests for signing, prompt-library, runner/contracts, and workflow-executor surfaces.

The gate must run under 'make test' with no CI-provider dependency, failing on surface drift with a clear 'run --update' remediation message, mirroring the existing config-key drift gate in scripts/gen_config_reference.py.
